body:
WHAT
Billed token usage accumulates for the whole session in a per-model ledger: every model call adds its four token classes to the entry for the model it ran on. The ledger is shared by reference with every subagent, and auxiliary calls (clarify pre-layer, auto-naming, compaction summarizer, vision descriptions) also add to it. It is snapshotted into the transcript meta record and restored by /resume.

WHY
Without a shared cumulative ledger the /session report would miss subagent and side-call spend, and a resumed session would show a zero bill.

WHERE
engine/protocol/src/tokens.ts — addUsage(), emptyUsage(). engine/core/src/runtime/sessionStats.ts — SessionStats.byModel, recordResponse(model, usage, apiMs, conversational) (always addUsage into byModel regardless of `conversational`), totalUsage(), snapshot(), SessionStats.fromSnapshot(). engine/core/src/runtime/session.ts — `this.stats = opts.stats ?? new SessionStats()` (children receive the parent's instance in spawnAgent), streamAssistantTurn → recordResponse, runInference/runSummarizer → recordResponse(…, false), runTurn finally writes transcript meta {stats: snapshot()} for the root.

TEST CHECKLIST
1. recordResponse('m', {inputTokens:10,outputTokens:5,cacheReadTokens:100,cacheWriteTokens:2}) twice yields byModel.get('m') = {20,10,200,4}; recordResponse('other', …) creates a separate entry and totalUsage() sums both.
2. recordResponse(model, usage, ms, false) (auxiliary) still adds to byModel and apiMs even though it does not touch contextTokens.
3. In a Session tree driven by a FakeProvider where the subagent runs on the same model, the root's stats.byModel total after the turn equals the sum of every FakeProvider turn's usage, parent and child included, and child.stats === parent.stats.
4. With settings.clarify on, the clarify side-call's usage and (when triggered) the compaction summarizer's usage appear in stats.byModel.
5. SessionStats.fromSnapshot(stats.snapshot()) reproduces byModel, apiMs, linesAdded/Removed and contextTokens; fromSnapshot(null) and fromSnapshot({}) return undefined without throwing.
